Has an explosion radius of 15. }} ==Description== The '''Unknown Small''', in-game displayed with randomly generated zalgo, is an enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It also appeared in [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]], appeared in the [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]] and appeared in the [[Nil Zone II]] as part of the [[Halloween 2026 Live Events]]. It has a decent amount of health for its debut and above average speed. It has one ability where, upon death, it will apply a 30% [[Fatigue Debuff]] and deal 20 damage to units in an explosion with a radius of 15. ==Logbook Description== "''There is not much to know about the Unknowns. Whether they are a lesser Unknown or a younger Unknown compared to the Unknown is still up for debate. What is known about them, though, is how they will violently implode upon death. It’s uncertain if even Void Caster knows much about them.''" ==Appearance== The '''Unknown Small''' is a corrupted black entity. It emits glitch particles and has fingers on its hand. It has multiple small humanoids on its body. ==Event Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]], [[Juggernaut]], [[Engineer]] or [[Pursuit]] are recommended against this. **The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] can also be quite useful at boosting their statistics. ***The [[Commander]] specifically can be used to partially mitigate its ability. *As it applies a debuff, majority forms of immunity to stuns will not work on its ability, meaning its effective on most towers. **The top path [[Juggernaut]] can be used to reduce the debuff duration. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseUnknownSmall.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (11 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator |'''Unknown''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} UnknownSmallIconIG.png|'''Unknown''' on its first [[Index]] icon.
